description: The list and chips editors of the Svelte 5 data grid, in single and multi-select forms. editorType: 'list' is a native select that becomes a multi-select with editorMultiple and stores an array; editorType: 'chips' edits removable tokens, with a picker when editorOptions are given and free-form typing when they are not. editorSeparator controls how array values are joined for display, and onCellValueChange reports each commit.

faq.question: How do I store several values in one cell?
faq.answer: Set editorMultiple on a list or chips column. The cell value becomes an array of option values; a chips column renders them as tokens when not editing, and editorSeparator sets the join string for a list column's display.

faq.question: Can users type their own tags?
faq.answer: Yes. A chips column without editorOptions is free-form: type a value and press Enter to add a token, click the x on a token to remove it.

faq.question: What shapes can editorOptions take?
faq.answer: An array of strings, of numbers, or of { value, label } objects. The label is what the dropdown and the chips show; the value is what lands in the row.
